propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 rejects every verification index as unexpected when Pass-1 yields zero findings, degrading all findings to INDETERMINATE

The root cause is that verify_instructions() returns an imperative instruction for an empty batch instead of signaling that no verifications are needed, causing the model to emit indices 0..N-1 against an empty findings list
INDETERMINATE findings cannot trigger a BLOCK decision; they silently pass when any advisory surfaces, making the failure mode unverified findings that are not caught
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, establishing the correct contract that no indices should be returned when no findings are present

The index-basis mismatch was definitively on the sent side (zero-finding runs), not the model's response, as proven by perfect separation across 3908 stored events and 2778 clean multi-finding runs with correct indices
After the fix, a live review-plan run with surfaced findings emits no contract violation and findings retain verified severity rather than degrading to INDETERMINATE
